name: Bok Yann
headline: AI Engineer · Builder · Photographer
introduction: I'm Bok Yann, an AI Engineer pursuing a part-time Master of Computing in Artificial Intelligence at the National University of Singapore. I love taking on new challenges and creating things that others can enjoy. Outside work, you'll often find me travelling with a camera—especially in Japan, my favourite country to explore.
availability: Working as an AI Engineer while studying part-time at NUS.

experience.title: AI Engineer / Technology Solutions Engineer
experience.summary: Translate factory users' operational needs into AI and digital solutions, from requirements and scoping through delivery and adoption. Build AI/ML products and full-stack applications serving 50–100 users across Singapore and ASEAN, alongside RFID and automation projects that removed 1,700 hours of manual work annually.

experience.title: Software Development Intern
experience.summary: Built a full-stack inventory management application using Flask, FastAPI, JavaScript and Oracle SQL. Adopted factory-wide for stocktake, it saved more than 2,000 hours of manual work annually.

experience.title: Data Science Intern
experience.summary: Trained a journey-time regression model that reduced travel-duration error by approximately 40%. Ran vehicle-routing simulations to optimise scheduling across 70–100 daily trips.

experience.title: Business Analyst Intern, Overseas Operations
experience.summary: Led a data engineering project connecting external sources to internal databases, saving $12,000–$15,000 annually in tooling and manual effort. Built Tableau and Python dashboards for regional sales and marketing decisions.

capabilities.label: AI systems
capabilities.detail: RAG, multi-agent orchestration, tool calling and evaluation with LangGraph, LangChain and hosted or open-weight models.

capabilities.label: Engineering & cloud
capabilities.detail: Python, FastAPI, Flask, JavaScript, Oracle SQL, Docker and AWS. AWS certified in Machine Learning, Solutions Architecture and Cloud Practitioner.

capabilities.label: From needs to delivery
capabilities.detail: Requirements gathering, solution design, stakeholder engagement and adoption across technical and operational teams.

interestsIntroduction: I love travelling, photography and discovering new places. Japan is my favourite country to explore—my photographs are a way to share the moments and details I notice along the way.
